rationale: ODCS-style models[] shape exercise. correctness=4 (good): PK + nullability + good numeric types (DOUBLE for metric_value, TIMESTAMP for collected_at). completeness=3 (acceptable): owner + cadence (streaming) set, no retention, no SLA. security=2 (below acceptable): tenant_id is a multi-tenant isolation marker but is untagged; site_code may be sensitive infrastructure data. governance=3: owner team contactable but no retention for streaming data, no access policies — minimum viable. performance=2: collected_at would naturally partition but no hint declared. documentation=3: layer + productType + cadence give context; per-column descriptions absent.
